g.text: MOD1: Adafruit 5807, configured for 12 V / 3 A.

g.desc: MOD1: Adafruit 5807, configured for 12 V / 3 A.

g.text: See README for release checks before fabrication/assembly.

g.desc: See README for release checks before fabrication/assembly.

g.text: K1: coil pins 1/5; COM 2, NO 3, NC 4.

g.desc: K1: coil pins 1/5; COM 2, NO 3, NC 4.

g.text: Electrical revision S4; native labels connect between blocks.

g.desc: Electrical revision S4; native labels connect between blocks.

g.text: Place C2 and C4 at U2 pins. Remove JP1 before

g.desc: Place C2 and C4 at U2 pins. Remove JP1 before

g.text: powering the WT32 from its own programming USB.

g.desc: powering the WT32 from its own programming USB.

g.text: Probe TIP_A and TIP_B contacts are intentionally joined.

g.desc: Probe TIP_A and TIP_B contacts are intentionally joined.

g.text: Module must provide local bypass and I2C pull-ups to VDD.

g.desc: Module must provide local bypass and I2C pull-ups to VDD.

g.text: Pin 1 = VDD; pin 10 = A3. Confirm module orientation.

g.desc: Pin 1 = VDD; pin 10 = A3. Confirm module orientation.

g.text: J8 is the owned 28 x 17 mm blue ADS1115 module.

g.desc: J8 is the owned 28 x 17 mm blue ADS1115 module.

g.text: Q1 mounts flat on a 1 mm insulating support.

g.desc: Q1 mounts flat on a 1 mm insulating support.

g.text: Q1: pin 1 gate; pin 2 drain/live tab; pin 3 source.

g.desc: Q1: pin 1 gate; pin 2 drain/live tab; pin 3 source.

g.text: Confirm connector, cable and stall-current limits.

g.desc: Confirm connector, cable and stall-current limits.

g.text: This connector is NOT Ethernet or PoE.

g.desc: This connector is NOT Ethernet or PoE.

g.text: RJ45: 1.5 A/contact; pin 4 is fan + servo return.

g.desc: RJ45: 1.5 A/contact; pin 4 is fan + servo return.

g.text: U2 supplies 5 V / 2 A total for WT32 and servo.

g.desc: U2 supplies 5 V / 2 A total for WT32 and servo.

g.text: Module fit, load tests and thermal validation remain required.

g.desc: Module fit, load tests and thermal validation remain required.

g.text: GPIO12 HIGH = fan ON; reset = OFF. Start PWM at 100 Hz.

g.desc: GPIO12 HIGH = fan ON; reset = OFF. Start PWM at 100 Hz.

g.text: RJ45: 1.5 A/contact; pin 4 carries fan + servo return.

g.desc: RJ45: 1.5 A/contact; pin 4 carries fan + servo return.

g.text: No onboard fuses: use protected/current-limited sources.

g.desc: No onboard fuses: use protected/current-limited sources.

g.text: D3 cathode is on raw WALL_12V; anode is on GND.

g.desc: D3 cathode is on raw WALL_12V; anode is on GND.

g.text: J9: 5.5 x 2.1 mm, regulated 12 V, center positive.

g.desc: J9: 5.5 x 2.1 mm, regulated 12 V, center positive.

g.text: J3 is the EXT cable. J7 takes only DEBUG pins 2 and 7.

g.desc: J3 is the EXT cable. J7 takes only DEBUG pins 2 and 7.

g.text: 3.3 V analog excitation and ADC power come from J7.

g.desc: 3.3 V analog excitation and ADC power come from J7.

g.text: No DC buzzer or magnetic speaker substitution.

g.desc: No DC buzzer or magnetic speaker substitution.

g.text: GPIO14 -> 330R -> passive piezo. Use about 4 kHz.

g.desc: GPIO14 -> 330R -> passive piezo. Use about 4 kHz.

g.text: NC: USB PD NO: wall COM: selected +12V

g.desc: NC: USB PD NO: wall COM: selected +12V

g.text: 12 V regulated / 3 A maximum sources; common GND.

g.desc: 12 V regulated / 3 A maximum sources; common GND.

g.text: The J9 sleeve switch (pin 3) is unused.

g.desc: The J9 sleeve switch (pin 3) is unused.

g.text: 06 THREE NTC PROBES / FILTERS / SOCKETED ADS1115

g.desc: 06 THREE NTC PROBES / FILTERS / SOCKETED ADS1115

g.text: NTC resistance = 10k * raw / (raw_supply - raw). Verify with known resistors before thermal calibration.

g.desc: NTC resistance = 10k * raw / (raw_supply - raw). Verify with known resistors before thermal calibration.
